# Template maintenance

Rules for the document templates here. Templates are skeletons, not instances; they follow the [documentation standard](../AGENTS.md) and the repository's Note rules file.

| Template | Use |
|---|---|
| root-readme.md | The root README's Intent sections, named in the [documentation standard](../AGENTS.md#the-intent-sections), for a repository that has none. |
| agent.md | A directory's `AGENTS.md`, only where local rules exist. |
| notes/*.md | Note bodies by lifecycle. |

Templates carry no frontmatter or id. READMEs use the `codas-doc-writing` templates. When a format changes, change its rule and the template together.
